description.p: Nook brings lights, plugs, sensors, cameras, air conditioners, TVs and speakers together in one place. The Home page shows every device by section and room: switch lights and plugs on and off, and see the temperature, the doors and the leak sensors at a glance.

It signs in to Home Assistant, Philips Hue, HomeKit, Smart Life, Mi Home and eWeLink, to the clouds of LG, Samsung, Mitsubishi Electric and Electrolux, and finds and pairs devices on the local network: Gree, Midea and Daikin air conditioners, Tapo and ONVIF cameras, Google Cast speakers, TVs, Sonoff and Shelly switches.
With the Nook extension for GNOME Shell, installed from extensions.gnome.org, the same devices are also in the top bar.
